investigator.mcp_server: read-only Prometheus HTTP API for the course snapshot

hypotheses.hypothesis: The incident was caused by `adFailure`: ad server errors appeared during the fault window while the healthy baseline had none.
hypotheses.evidence: The error ratio was about 4.76% at 05:06:30Z and the comparison returned nothing at the 04:56:00Z baseline.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The latency-and-load fault was `intlShippingSlowdown`: shipping p99 exceeded 5 seconds and checkout p99 rose above 2 seconds.
hypotheses.predicts: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name="shipping",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER"}[5m]))) > 5000 and on() histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name="checkout",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER"}[5m]))) > 2000
hypotheses.evidence: Shipping p99 was approximately 8.1 s and checkout p99 approximately 8.8 s. The combined comparison was false on the healthy baseline.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The resource fault was `emailMemoryLeak`: email container memory was more than 40% above its value ten minutes earlier, while recommendation memory stayed near baseline.
hypotheses.evidence: Email memory was 1.448 times its ten-minute-earlier value while recommendation was only 1.020. The email comparison was false at the healthy baseline.
